title: The Human Side of ML Engineering: Analyzing the Collaboration and Communication Skills in ML Job Postings
abstract: arXiv:2611.18915v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Studies of Machine Learning (ML) practice highlight the importance of combining technical expertise with interpersonal capabilities, particularly collaboration and communication. However, evidence on how ML job postings express these skills is scarce, and prior work largely relies on keyword-based analyses that overlook implicit expression. We analyze demand for these skills in ML job postings across regions, industries, and seniority levels, and compare it with software engineering (SE) roles. We collected 1,000 postings (500 ML, 500 SE) from five continents via a semi-automated pipeline. For annotation, we synthesized a taxonomy of collaboration and communication sub-categories from prior work and used an LLM as a third annotator alongside two humans, enabling detection of context-dependent and implicit skill references. Collaboration appeared in 88.6% of ML postings and communication in 72.2%, far above prior keyword-based estimates

translated_title: 机器学习工程中的人性一面：分析机器学习招聘信息中的协作与沟通技能
translated_abstract: 对机器学习（ML）实践的研究强调了将技术专长与人际能力相结合的重要性，尤其是协作与沟通能力。然而，关于ML招聘信息如何表达这些技能的证据十分匮乏，且以往研究主要依赖基于关键词的分析方法，忽略了隐性表达。我们分析了ML招聘信息中这些技能在不同地区、行业和资历级别上的需求情况，并将其与软件工程（SE）职位进行对比。我们通过半自动化流程从五大洲收集了1,000份招聘信息（500份ML，500份SE）。在标注环节，我们从已有研究中综合出协作与沟通子类别的分类体系，并使用大语言模型（LLM）作为第三位标注者与两位人类标注者协同工作，从而能够识别依赖上下文的和隐性的技能表述。结果显示，协作技能出现在88.6%的ML招聘信息中，沟通技能出现在72.2%中，远高于以往基于关键词的估计。
tldr: 该研究通过LLM辅助人工标注的方法分析五大洲1000份招聘信息，发现ML职位对协作和沟通技能的需求（分别达88.6%和72.2%）远高于以往基于关键词分析的估计，且能够捕捉隐性和上下文相关的技能表述。
en_tdlr: Using LLM-assisted annotation on 1,000 job postings from five continents, this study reveals that collaboration (88.6%) and communication (72.2%) skills are far more prevalent in ML job postings than prior keyword-based estimates suggested, while capturing implicit and context-dependent skill references.
